name: python-regos-integrations
description: FastAPI gateway service that exposes a unified REST interface over the REGOS API and hosts pluggable client integrations (Telegram bots, SMS gateways, EDO/e-invoicing providers, CRM channels, marketplaces, and a TSD warehouse PWA). Wrapper services validate REGOS calls with Pydantic models, while clients connect via webhooks and external handlers backed by Redis and MariaDB. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
